name: cheapgen
description: Sends each AI video or image generation to the cheapest provider you have a key for (Kie, Replicate, WaveSpeed, fal). Quotes first and asks before spending.

kie_api_key.title: Kie API key
kie_api_key.description: Optional. Leave empty to use a key stored with `cheapgen config set-key kie`.

replicate_api_token.title: Replicate API key
replicate_api_token.description: Optional. Leave empty to use a key stored with `cheapgen config set-key replicate`.

wavespeed_api_key.title: WaveSpeed API key
wavespeed_api_key.description: Optional. Leave empty to use a key stored with `cheapgen config set-key wavespeed`.

fal_key.title: fal API key
fal_key.description: Optional. Leave empty to use a key stored with `cheapgen config set-key fal`.
